label: Settings problems
means: Settings files that fail to parse, unknown keys, and permission rules Claude Code skips or ignores.
goal_source: template goal from the docs: Claude Code skips a broken file or entry with a Settings Error or Warning (code.claude.com/docs/en/settings, read 2026-11-04), so none should have one
source: state: each file in params.files that exists, parsed as strict JSON; top-level and permissions keys against the settings index (code.claude.com/docs/en/settings-reference, read 2026-11-04); permissions.defaultMode against the modes (code.claude.com/docs/en/permission-modes); each allow, ask and deny rule against the rule syntax (code.claude.com/docs/en/permissions, read 2026-11-04; ruleProblem() in quality/collectors/claude/claude-settings.mjs)

params.comment: files: the settings files the repo commits, paths from the repo root. A user's own .claude/settings.local.json is left out: it is not the repo's, and CI never has it. extra_keys: top-level keys newer than the settings index this file was written from, so a new key is not a problem.

label: Credential paths Claude cannot read
means: Share of credential paths, such as .env and keys, that the repo's Claude Code settings deny reading; higher is better.
goal_source: Anthropic, Claude Code settings: permissions.deny with Read(./.env) and Read(./.env.*) keeps secrets out of Claude's reach (code.claude.com/docs/en/settings, read 2026-11-13). Moved from Git Crafter v4.6.4, which dropped it (#7)
source: state: the Read(...) rules in permissions.deny of each file in params.files, against params.credential_patterns (denyMetric() in collectors/claude/claude-settings.mjs)

label: Claudius files in place
means: Share of the Claudius setup files the repo commits: AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, settings, the reviewer agent, the skills.
goal_source: template goal: Claudius templates/claude/README.md lists each file a repo copies, and a missing one leaves a step of the build flow with nothing behind it
source: state: each path in params.setup_files exists in the repo (setupMetric() in collectors/claude/claude-settings.mjs)

label: Permission prompts per 100 tool calls
means: Tool calls that stopped for a person to approve them; each is a wait and a defect.
goal_source: template goal: work runs without prompts; auto and bypassPermissions modes exist so it can (code.claude.com/docs/en/permission-modes, read 2026-11-04)
source: this repo's transcripts: the permissionDecision of each tool result, newest 1,000 that carry one; a prompt is a source starting user (user_temporary, user_permanent). ExitPlanMode and AskUserQuestion are left out: asking is their job. N = 1,000 tool calls, so new work replaces old within hours

params.comment: projects_dir: where Claude Code keeps session transcripts (~/ is under home). project_match: the project folder name to read; default the main checkout's (projectMatch() in claude.mjs), which covers its worktrees.
